title: Ferrostorm damage matrix (GDD s6)
description: P7-15. The warhead-versus-armour percentage matrix, the last gameplay number to leave code. Exactly one file lives in data/combat and schemagate checks every key here against it on each build. Each row is four percentages in ARMOUR ORDER (none, light, heavy, structure) applied as base * pct / 100 with integer truncation, which is load-bearing for determinism. The matrix is folded into World.CatalogueChecksum, so two peers holding different files refuse to play rather than desyncing.

id.description: Exactly one matrix exists, so the id is fixed. A second file would be a second source of truth for the same numbers.
